parsed.post: Discarding my last run (1.0021); it was slightly worse than my previous best (1.0012). Reverting to DEPTH=6, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144, MATRIX_LR=0.05, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01. Next experiment: I'll try reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to see if a more conservative step improves convergence at this batch size.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to test if a more conservative learning rate improves convergence with the current DEPTH=6 and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 configuration.
